title: Atorada language
description: Arawakan language of Brazil and Guyana
extract: Atorada or Atoraí is a moribund Arawakan language of Brazil and Guyana. There were only a few speakers as of 2000. The language is poorly documented, and it is frequently seen as a dialect of closely related Wapishana.
